note: Municipal District of Wainwright recreation area around Arm Lake, 16 km east and 12 km south of Wainwright: sites sheltered by trees, a public beach, three playgrounds, a 9-hole golf course, 15 km of nature trails and a family centre with a concession. Weekly, monthly and full-season rates are sold alongside the daily ones. --Claude
summary: MD of Wainwright pages read (rates 'Effective for the 2026 Season'). Confirmed stored fees C$26-32 (unserviced C$15), 130 sites, water and sewer hookups, showers, laundry, dump, phone.
